rappel_detail.anchor: semi-permanent boulder or horn anchor with slings and a rap ring at the top of the block; inspect and back up
rappel_detail.station: The top of the West Peak summit block, which is recorded at 80-100 ft high.
rappel_detail.notes: One rappel down the north side of the block, the pitch climbed on the way up, to the snow at its base. A 60 m rope used doubled is needed to reach.
